title: Law to require water reuse systems in large buildings
summary: This bill would require properties over 100,000 square feet to install and maintain on-site nonpotable water reuse systems, subject to a permit from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. It also directs the Department of Environmental Protection to create a program offering grants, fee discounts and other incentives for water reuse and efficiency upgrades on private property. The law would take effect one year after enactment, applying to construction documents filed after that date.
